Terms.Name: Combine Civil Code
Terms.Description: The 'law' imposed by the Combine Civil Authority

Terms.Name: Civic trust
Terms.Description: The 'trust' in a citizen to be law-abiding. Crimes are a breach of civic trust

Terms.Name: Loyalty check procedure
Terms.Description: A performative test/instruction to gauge a citizen's obedience/status

Terms.Name: Memory replacement
Terms.Description: To receive a memory-altering procedure that washes away traumatic or negative sensations as part of the transhuman conversion process

Terms.Name: Recall and recycle
Terms.Description: Withdraw from assigned objective and face disciplinary action

Terms.Name: Miscount
Terms.Description: Less or more citizens than to be accounted for

Terms.Name: Incursion
Terms.Description: A hostile breach of a Combine-controlled area

Terms.Name: Permissive inactive coercion
Terms.Description: Failure of an individual to report malcompliance in the community

Terms.Name: Viral interface bypass
Terms.Description: Unauthorized security systems breach/hacking a Combine interface

Terms.Name: Socio-endangerment
Terms.Description: Actions that threaten the stability of an urban zone

Terms.Name: Malignancy
Terms.Description: Organized disobedience or dissent against the Combine

Terms.Name: Active signature imprint
Terms.Description: A strong energy signature from a specified location

Terms.Name: Passive signature imprint
Terms.Description: A faint energy signature from a specified region
